about.title: About Me
about.bio_p1: I am a Computer Science Engineering student who turned a passion for competitive programming and algorithmic puzzles into a career building intelligent systems. My journey started with breaking down complex data structures in Java and Python on GeeksforGeeks, which evolved into a deep fascination with operating systems and artificial intelligence.
about.bio_p2: Currently, I operate at the intersection of infrastructure and innovation. My technical experience ranges from hands-on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) system administration-managing LVM, firewalls, and secure environments-to designing custom AI operating layers and touchless, vision-based user interfaces.
about.bio_p3: I believe in engineering with absolute precision while maintaining a creative edge, whether I am optimizing server scripts, building human-computer interaction models, or editing high-impact digital content.
